description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength, which validates 'multilength' attribute values in accordance with HTML specifications. It extends the HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Length class and provides specific validation logic for pixels, percentages, and relative multipliers.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_MultiLength
classes.description: A class that validates multi-length attribute values for HTML elements, supporting pixel, percentage, and relative specifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether a given string is a valid multi-length value (pixels, percentage, or star notation), returning the processed value or false if invalid.
